run_sequential_finetuning: run the Kronos sequential fine-tuning trainer with a YAML config file via argparse CLI
train_tokenizer_phase: train the Kronos tokenizer phase with optional pretrained loading and skip-existing support
train_basemodel_phase: train the Kronos basemodel predictor phase using the fine-tuned tokenizer
create_sequential_trainer: create a SequentialTrainer instance from a YAML config path for distributed training setup
setup_distributed_training: setup torch.distributed process group with NCCL backend for multi-GPU training
